title: Lakenheath 1956 incident

tellings.quote: nuclear weapons. Lake and Heath was one of the the the site of one of the most extraordinary historical accounts 1956. James McDonald wrote um quite a bit about this

plain: Michels calls a 1956 sighting at RAF Lakenheath, a base in England linked in the conversation to nuclear weapons, "one of the most extraordinary historical accounts" of its kind. He brings it up himself, without saying what was seen. He notes that the scientist James McDonald wrote a good deal about it and points to CIA documents and a write-up hosted at princeton.edu.
